annotations.title: Request a human review or decision

description: Escalate to a human reviewer: approve or correct output, check quality against a rubric, or resolve an ambiguous decision (EN/DE). Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 1–20 per task depending on effort.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

material.description: The content to review (text) or a URL to it.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

task.description: What the reviewer should decide or check.
